PNG files submitted to Adobe Stock must meet defined technical and quality requirements to support consistent previews, accurate search results, and reliable customer downloads. Adhering to these standards helps maintain accurate color reproduction, proper transparency, and high-quality assets suitable for a wide range of creative projects. Files that don't comply with these specifications may be refused during the moderation process. Specifications Requirements Details Image resolution 4MP-100MP (megapixels) Images must meet minimum resolution requirements to maintain quality standards. Higher‑resolution files provide greater flexibility, especially for print projects where detail and clarity are essential. File size 45MB maximum Compressed file size limit for upload processing. File format PNG PNG format with transparency support. Color profile sRGB Standard RGB color space required for consistent color reproduction. Background None File must be saved with transparent background, not solid color. Watermarks Not allowed Files must be free of watermarks, timestamps, or branding. Image quality guidelines In addition to meeting technical specifications, PNG files submitted to Adobe Stock must follow defined quality standards to support professional results and provide broad usability across creative projects.
